candidate.name: Circle CCTP V2 native USDC cross-chain burn/mint attestations
candidate.reproduction: Circle documents GET https://iris-api.circle.com/v2/messages/{sourceDomain}?transactionHash={sourceBurnTxHash}; source-chain TokenMessengerV2 depositForBurn emits message; Iris attests after confirmations; destination MessageTransmitterV2 receiveMessage mints. A valid source burn transaction hash and matching destination receipt would be required to reproduce an observation. No live transaction payload or block-pinned event was obtained this run.

criteria.first_party_machine_readable: DOCUMENTED_PASS_LIVE_UNVERIFIED: Circle documents public GET /v2/messages and signed attestation; no concrete live message observed
criteria.immutable_event_identity: PARTIAL: onchain burn transaction hash, message nonce and destination receipt can identify an event; no specific source block hash/transaction/log index or destination receipt captured
criteria.economic_entity_scope: FAIL_FOR_NEW_CAPITAL: native USDC transfer across chain domains, not independent USDC issuance, BTC exchange reserve, BTC custody, treasury or BTC purchasing-capital inflow
criteria.effective_clock: UNVERIFIED: source burn block time would be effective time; no source block was captured
criteria.available_clock: FAIL: first historical public attestation availability and finality time per event not established; do not equate burn time with signed attestation availability
criteria.observed_clock: Documentation inspected 2026-10-10 08:28 ICT; no API response or onchain event bytes observed
criteria.non_overlap: FAIL: source-chain USDC burn and destination-chain USDC mint represent the same transfer, not two capital events. Counting destination mint as independent new USDC supply double-counts existing aggregate stablecoin supply/chain relocation; no reconciliation to existing stablecoin source proved
criteria.context_only: If ever used, cross-chain transfer/bridge state is nondirectional context_only, non-additive; no Capital Flow score or BUY/SELL inference

candidate.rejection: First-party machine-readable protocol exists, but the economics are redistribution of existing USDC between chains rather than independent new purchasing capital; no live immutable event, no complete three PIT clocks, and no demonstrated non-overlap. PLATEAU; no implementation task.
candidate.next_evidence: Seek a genuinely independent BTC custody, miner, treasury or purchasing-capital source with first-party durable machine-readable records, immutable event/report/block identity, full effective/available/observed clocks, quantified non-overlap and context-only custody stock. Do not retry previously rejected sources without new reproducible proof.
